title: Level-of-Token Diffusion
title_zh: Token 层级（Level-of-Token, LoT）扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion , a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout ( Level-of-Token layout ) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality–efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout’s token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/ .
paragraphs.zh: 图像和视频扩散模型为每个区域分配了均等的计算资源，即使目标场景需要不同层次的细节。 细节的空间分布通常可以在生成前预测，从而确定哪些区域的计算可以简化。 我们提出了“令牌层级”（LoT）扩散框架，该框架将这一知识转化为显式的多分辨率令牌布局（“令牌层级”布局），以实现自适应的高效生成。 令牌代表不同大小和形状的矩形区域，在需要细节的位置分配更精细的令牌，在其他位置则使用更粗的令牌。 我们通过基于块的不对称流参数化以及多分辨率令牌的嵌入，将预训练的扩散变换器适配到“令牌层级”布局中，从而在每次去噪步骤都保留全分辨率的流预测，同时仅处理缩短后的令牌序列。 “令牌层级”扩散能够在保持预训练生成先验的同时，实现布局自适应的生成。 我们展示了基于语义掩码、边界框、纹理差异和景深线索以及智能体计划所生成的布局在“令牌层级”中的应用。 在图像和视频生成中，“令牌层级”实现了良好的质量与效率权衡，其加速效果显著且取决于布局中的令牌数量。 我们的项目网站位于 https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/ 。

paragraphs.en: Image and video generative models produce remarkably high-quality content, yet generating high-resolution images and long videos remains computationally expensive. Much of this cost comes from diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) processing long sequences of spatial tokens through attention and linear layers at every denoising step. Reducing this cost begins with recognizing that not all regions require the same level of detail: intricate textures, faces, and text require fine detail, while clear skies, blurred backgrounds, and flat surfaces can be synthesized more coarsely. Pretrained models nevertheless allocate equal computation to all regions. Allocating resources according to the detail needed is well established in level-of-detail rendering ( Clark, 1976 ) , variable-rate shading ( Vaidyanathan et al., 2014 ) , and image compression ( Shapiro, 1993 ) . Whereas rendering and compression operate on existing scene or image content, generation can begin with a specified distribution of detail before the final pixels are available. Notably, such knowledge can come from the structure, description, or plan of the intended scene, which generative models increasingly support through richer prompting and explicit layout specification ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Reve AI, 2026 ; Ideogram, 2026a ) . These observations motivate using prior knowledge of where detail matters to determine how to allocate compute for generation.
paragraphs.zh: 图像和视频生成模型能够产出质量极高的内容，但生成高分辨率图像和长视频在计算上仍然成本高昂。 其中大部分成本源于扩散变换器（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）在每次去噪步骤中，通过注意机制和线性层处理长序列的空间标记。 降低这一成本首先要认识到，并非所有区域都需要同等程度的细节：复杂的纹理、人脸和文本需要精细细节，而晴朗的天空、模糊的背景和平坦的表面则可以更粗略地合成。 然而，预训练模型仍会平均分配计算资源给所有区域。 根据所需细节分配资源的做法在细节层次渲染（Clark，1976）、可变率着色（Vaidyanathan 等，2014）和图像压缩（Shapiro，1993）中已有广泛应用。 与渲染和压缩处理现有场景或图像内容不同，生成过程可以在最终像素可用之前，先基于指定的细节分布开始。 值得注意的是，这类知识可以来自目标场景的结构、描述或规划，而生成模型正通过更丰富的提示和显式布局指定（OpenAI，2026；Reve AI，2026；Ideogram，2026a）日益支持这些方式。 这些观察结果促使我们利用先验知识——即哪些区域需要细节——来决定如何分配生成所需的计算资源。

paragraphs.en: Ideally, a generative model would use this prior knowledge both to adapt where fine detail is concentrated and to reduce computation. Spatial conditioning methods ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Mou et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2023 ) guide generated content using spatial inputs, but retain full-resolution processing and often introduce additional computational cost. Efficiency methods exploit redundancy through either reusing intermediate computations ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Zou et al., 2024 ) or token reduction ( Bolya and Hoffman, 2023 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Jeong et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Chao et al., 2026 ) , but do not utilize this adaptivity as a control mechanism. Our goal is to use prior knowledge to control where fine detail is concentrated and allocate computation accordingly, enabling both adaptive and efficient generation.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion , in which an image or video is synthesized from a content-adaptive, multiresolution token layout ( Level-of-Token Layout ). Each token represents a rectangular spatial patch with variable extent, specified by its height and width, allowing important regions to be finely tokenized while less important ones are tokenized coarsely. Realizing this on pretrained diffusion transformers requires adapting models trained on uniform grids to heterogeneous token layouts. To this end, we develop a formulation that preserves full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while the transformer processes only a reduced token sequence. We achieve this through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parameterization ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , together with adaptations to token embeddings and positional encoding that account for various patch extents. Fine-tuning pretrained models within our simple framework enables efficient generation that adapts to the specified layout while leveraging their generative priors.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了“令牌层级”（Level-of-Token, LoT）扩散模型，该模型能够根据内容自适应的多分辨率令牌布局（令牌层级布局）合成图像或视频。 每个令牌代表一个尺寸可变、由高度和宽度定义的矩形空间区域，这使得重要区域可以被精细划分，而次要区域则只需粗略划分。 要在预训练的扩散变换器上实现这一点，需要将原本基于均匀网格训练的模型适配到异构的令牌布局中。 为此，我们设计了一种公式，能够在每次去噪步骤中保留全分辨率的流预测，同时仅让变换器处理缩短后的令牌序列。 我们通过一种基于块的不对称流参数化方法（Chen et al., 2026）实现了这一目标，并结合了对令牌嵌入和位置编码的调整，以适配不同尺寸的块区域。 在我们的简单框架内对预训练模型进行微调，能够在利用其生成先验知识的同时，高效地生成适配指定布局的内容。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate LoT across diverse layout sources, including semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Generation speedup depends on the token budget specified by the layout, reaching up to 2.04 × 2.04\times for images and 3.53 × 3.53\times for videos on average relative to the full-resolution pretrained models. Across the evaluated budgets, LoT offers favorable tradeoffs between generation quality and efficiency compared with existing token-reduction methods. Qualitative results further show how generated content adapts to the specified token layout. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/ .

paragraphs.en: To summarize, our main contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Level-of-Token Diffusion , a framework for efficient image and video generation with token layouts that adaptively vary patch size and shape across an image or video.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种“令牌级别扩散”（Level-of-Token Diffusion）框架，该框架能够高效生成图像和视频，其令牌布局可在整个图像或视频中自适应地调整区块的大小和形状。

paragraphs.en: We adapt pretrained DiTs through patch-wise asymmetric flow and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, enabling full-resolution flow prediction at every step from a reduced token sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过基于分块的不对称流和多分辨率标记嵌入来适配预训练的 DiT，从而能够从简化后的标记序列中，在每一步都实现全分辨率的流预测。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate favorable quality and efficiency tradeoffs across image and video generation, using layouts derived from scene cues and agentic plans.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了在图像和视频生成中，基于场景提示和智能体计划所生成的布局，能够在质量与效率之间实现理想的权衡。

paragraphs.en: A large body of work improves the efficiency of diffusion models along several axes. Along the spatial axis, token merging and pruning techniques identify redundant tokens and merge or discard them based on predefined heuristics or learned criteria ( Bolya and Hoffman, 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Haurum et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) , while sparse attention mechanisms exploit sparse patterns in the attention maps and use block-wise computation to reduce the quadratic cost of self-attention ( Li et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Zhan et al., 2025 ; Katharopoulos et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Choromanski et al., 2020 ; Beltagy et al., 2020 ) . Along the timestep axis, feature caching methods reuse intermediate features across denoising steps to avoid redundant computation ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Zou et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2024 ) , whereas distillation and sampler-based approaches reduce the number of denoising steps themselves, either by training a student to approximate a pretrained teacher ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) or by deriving faster solvers and consistency-based samplers ( Song et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2023 ) . Other progressive-upsampling methods grow the spatial resolution over the course of generation to save computation in early stages ( Jeong et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods treat spatial regions equally, operating along denoising-trajectory or attention-level axes independent of how details are spatially distributed, and thus leave the prior knowledge of where content requires computation unexploited.

paragraphs.en: Content-adaptive tokenization is an orthogonal and complementary axis that exploits exactly this prior, accelerating generation by allocating compute based on the content. However, existing approaches address only part of the problem: some are spatially adaptive but with no or limited user control ( Chao et al., 2026 ; Haridas et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Zamfir et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2025a ) , others adapt the token budget without redistributing it across space ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Bachmann et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Duggal et al., 2024 ; Haji-Ali et al., 2026 ) , and still others achieve spatial adaptivity but require training from scratch and are incompatible with pretrained diffusion models ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Aasan et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, our method is spatially adaptive and compatible with various pretrained models, redistributing tokens non-uniformly according to an intended layout while additionally exposing user control over the allocation. Most importantly, our method greatly accelerates image and video generation while remaining compatible with the other efficiency techniques above.
paragraphs.zh: 内容自适应分词是一个正交且互补的维度，它充分利用了这一先验知识，通过根据内容分配计算资源来加速生成。 然而，现有方法仅解决了问题的一部分：有些方法在空间上是自适应的，但用户控制有限或不存在（Chao et al., 2026；Haridas et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2025b；Zamfir et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2025a）；另一些方法则调整了分词预算，但未在空间上重新分配（Yan et al., 2025；Bachmann et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2025；Shen et al., 2025；Duggal et al., 2024；Haji-Ali et al., 2026）；还有一些方法实现了空间自适应，但需要从头训练，且与预训练的扩散模型不兼容（Zhang et al., 2025c；Jia et al., 2025；Aasan et al., 2026）。 相比之下，我们的方法在空间上是自适应的，并且与多种预训练模型兼容。它会根据预期的布局非均匀地重新分配分词单元，同时还允许用户对分配过程进行控制。 最重要的是，我们的方法能够显著加速图像和视频生成，同时仍与上述其他效率技术保持兼容。

paragraphs.en: A large body of work augments diffusion models with explicit control over object placement and scene composition. Prior conditioning-based methods attach trainable modules onto a frozen backbone, injecting spatial signals such as depth, segmentation masks, or bounding boxes, so that users can dictate where content appears ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Mou et al., 2024 ) . More recently, another line of work makes layout a direct input to the model rather than a separate branch, encoding it into tokens that enter the denoising sequence ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) or expressing it as structured text in the prompt itself ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . Most strikingly, the strongest deployed systems have made layout their primary interface: Ideogram 4.0 is trained exclusively on structured JSON captions carrying a description and a bounding box per element ( Ideogram, 2026b ) , and Reve 2 derives a hierarchical layout from the input text prompt before rendering from it ( Reve AI, 2026 ) . However, in all these methods the layout merely decides what appears where , never how much compute is allocated to it. A region the layout identifies as empty sky is still generated on the same dense token grid as detailed typography. In contrast, our method uses this prior knowledge of where detail matters to allocate computation spatially, enabling content-adaptive generation with fewer tokens. Semantic masks and depth-of-field cues identify regions that can be generated more coarsely, allowing LoT to reduce computation there while preserving finer tokenization where detail is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 大量研究通过显式控制物体放置和场景构图来增强扩散模型。 早期的基于条件约束的方法将可训练的模块附加到冻结的主干网络上，注入深度、分割掩码或边界框等空间信号，从而让用户能够指定内容出现的位置（Zhang et al., 2023；Mou et al., 2024）。 近期，另一类研究将布局作为模型的直接输入而非独立分支，将其编码为进入去噪序列的令牌（Tan et al., 2025；Xiao et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a），或在提示本身中以结构化文本的形式表达（Yang et al., 2023）。 最引人注目的是，性能最强的部署系统已将布局作为其主要接口：Ideogram 4.0 完全基于包含每个元素描述和边界框的结构化 JSON 标题进行训练（Ideogram, 2026b），而 Reve 2 则在渲染前从输入文本提示中推导出分层布局（Reve AI, 2026）。 然而，在所有这些方法中，布局仅决定“内容出现在何处”，从未涉及“分配多少计算资源”。 布局识别出的空天空区域，仍与精细排版的文字在同一密集令牌网格上生成。 相比之下，我们的方法利用这些关于细节重要位置的先验知识进行空间计算分配，从而实现内容自适应的生成，并减少令牌使用量。 语义掩码和景深提示能够识别出可以以更粗略方式生成的区域，使 LoT 能够在这些区域减少计算量，同时在需要细节的地方保留更精细的令牌化。

paragraphs.en: A LoT layout reduces the DiT sequence length from H ​ W HW to L L , but adapting a pretrained latent diffusion model to this reduced sequence presents two challenges. paragraphs.en: We introduced Level-of-Token Diffusion, a framework that uses level-of-detail information to guide efficient multiresolution image and video generation. By adapting pretrained diffusion models to variable token layouts, LoT connects control over detail with computational savings. Across diverse layout sources, our results demonstrate generation that adapts to the specified layout, with substantial speedups and favorable quality–efficiency tradeoffs over token-reduction baselines. We note that scenes requiring fine structures or textures throughout offer limited opportunities for token reduction, and aggressive compression can degrade their fidelity. LoT is therefore most advantageous when detail requirements vary spatially, allowing computation to be reduced selectively. See Sec. A.14 for a more detailed discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“令牌级别扩散”（Level-of-Token Diffusion）框架，该框架利用细节级别信息来指导高效的多分辨率图像和视频生成。 通过将预训练的扩散模型适配到可变令牌布局中，“LoT”将细节控制与计算效率的提升联系起来。 在多种布局来源的测试中，我们的结果表明，生成的结果能够适应指定的布局，并且相比基于令牌削减的基线方法，实现了显著的速度提升和更优的质量-效率权衡。 我们注意到，需要全局精细结构或纹理的场景中，令牌削减的机会有限，而过度压缩可能会降低其保真度。 因此，“LoT”在细节需求随空间位置变化的情况下最为有利，因为它允许选择性地减少计算量。更多详细讨论请参见第 A.14 节。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, LoT suggests a closer connection between planning and efficient generation. Our demonstrations with agentic plans for images and videos provide an initial step, turning planned spatial importance into an explicit computational allocation. Level-of-Token layouts could serve as an editable intermediate representation, allowing multimodal systems and users to refine a visual plan and its computational budget. Extending this interaction to video could support faster iterations between planning and synthesis in robotics and interactive simulation, where low generation latency is essential for responsive interaction. More broadly, LoT offers a step toward generative systems that use their understanding of the intended content to decide where computation is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未来，LoT 表明规划与高效生成之间可以建立更紧密的联系。 我们针对图像和视频的智能体规划演示迈出了第一步，将规划出的空间重要性转化为明确的计算资源分配。 Token 层级布局可作为一种可编辑的中间表示，使多模态系统和用户能够优化视觉规划及其计算预算。 若将这种交互扩展到视频领域，便可支持机器人与交互式模拟中规划与合成之间的更快速迭代，而低生成延迟对于响应迅速的交互至关重要。 更广泛地说，LoT 为生成式系统迈向一个新阶段提供了方向：这些系统能够基于对预期内容的理解，决定计算资源应分配至何处。

paragraphs.en: Users can specify where to allocate computation by painting a spatial detail map, without requiring a reference image or an automatically extracted mask. An agent can also construct this map programmatically from a text description. In our image-generation interface, each pixel is assigned the score of its nearest brush color: black, orange, yellow, and white correspond to detail scores 0 0 , 0.3 0.3 , 0.6 0.6 , and 1 1 , respectively. The canvas initially uses yellow to provide medium detail throughout the image. We area-average the scores onto the finest token lattice, optionally apply Gaussian smoothing, and multiply by a user-controlled gain before clipping to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . This gives a detail field D ⁡ ( 𝒒 ) D(\bm{q}) , where larger values request finer tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 用户可以通过绘制空间细节图来指定计算资源的分配位置，而无需参考图像或自动提取的掩码。 智能体也可以根据文本描述以编程方式构建此地图。 在我们的图像生成界面中，每个像素都被分配了其最近画笔颜色的分数：黑色、橙色、黄色和白色分别对应细节分数 0、0.3、0.6 和 1。 画布最初使用黄色为整个图像提供中等细节。 我们将这些分数按区域平均到最精细的标记网格上，可选择性地应用高斯平滑处理，然后乘以用户控制的增益，最后裁剪至 [0, 1] 范围。 这样便得到了一个细节场 D(𝒒)，其中较大的值表示需要更精细的标记。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 14 (a) compares FID and pFID against the held-out reference images, together with the image-quality metrics MUSIQ and TOPIQ, averaged over the test images at each threshold. Overall, LoT-FLUX.2-4B achieves lower FID and pFID and higher image-quality scores than FLUX.2 (token matched). In contrast, the pretrained baseline reduces resolution uniformly, and subsequent upsampling cannot recover fine details lost during low-resolution generation. Fig. 14 (b) provides qualitative comparisons, with each token-matched output displayed at its generation scale relative to our 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 output.

paragraphs.en: Figures 10 – 13 show how generation changes as the target token budget B B varies for the same prompt. We guide token allocation using semantic masks in Figures 10 and 11 , and texture variance in Figures 12 and 13 . Lower budgets use larger tokens over more of the image, retaining recognizable subjects and scene structure while simplifying fine textures. Higher budgets support finer spatial detail, such as foliage, fur, and architectural features. These results illustrate a controllable trade-off between computational budget and visual detail within the same model.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10 – 13 展示了在相同提示下，随着目标令牌预算 B 的变化，生成结果如何改变。 我们在图 10 和图 11 中使用语义掩码，在图 12 和图 13 中使用纹理方差来指导令牌分配。 较低的预算会在图像更大范围内使用更大的令牌，保留可识别的主体和场景结构，同时简化精细纹理。 较高的预算能够支持更精细的空间细节，例如植被、毛发和建筑特征。 这些结果展示了在同一模型中，计算预算与视觉细节之间可控的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: Figures 15 – 18 show additional image generation examples generated by LoT-FLUX.2-4B using LoT layouts derived from different sources. Bounding boxes and semantic masks concentrate fine tokens in selected regions, where the model places salient subjects and detailed structures. paragraphs.en: We evaluate six VBench [ Huang et al., 2024 ] dimensions using its custom-video evaluation on our held-out prompts. For image quality, aesthetic quality measures visual appeal, while imaging quality assesses perceptual degradation such as blur and noise. For temporal consistency, subject consistency measures the stability of subject appearance across frames, while background consistency measures the stability of the scene background. For motion, motion smoothness measures the continuity of movement, while dynamic degree measures the prevalence of substantial motion. Higher quality, consistency, and smoothness scores are better; a higher dynamic degree indicates more motion, not necessarily more realistic motion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 VBench [ Huang et al., 2024 ] 的自定义视频评估方法，在其预留提示语上对其六个维度进行了评估。 在图像质量方面，美学质量衡量视觉吸引力，而成像质量则评估模糊和噪声等感知退化问题。 在时间一致性方面，主体一致性衡量主体外观在各帧之间的稳定性，而背景一致性则衡量场景背景的稳定性。 在运动方面，运动平滑度衡量动作的连续性，而动态程度则衡量显著运动的普遍性。 质量、一致性和平滑度的分数越高越好；动态程度较高表示运动更多，但并不一定意味着运动更真实。

sents.en: For temporal consistency, subject consistency measures the stability of subject appearance across frames, while background consistency measures the stability of the scene background.
sents.zh: 在时间一致性方面，主体一致性衡量主体外观在各帧之间的稳定性，而背景一致性则衡量场景背景的稳定性。

sents.en: For motion, motion smoothness measures the continuity of movement, while dynamic degree measures the prevalence of substantial motion.
sents.zh: 在运动方面，运动平滑度衡量动作的连续性，而动态程度则衡量显著运动的普遍性。

sents.en: Higher quality, consistency, and smoothness scores are better; a higher dynamic degree indicates more motion, not necessarily more realistic motion.
sents.zh: 质量、一致性和平滑度的分数越高越好；动态程度较高表示运动更多，但并不一定意味着运动更真实。

paragraphs.en: For efficiency, runtime is the mean H100 generation time per video that includes both denoising and VAE decoding, similar to the image generation case.
paragraphs.zh: 为提升效率，运行时是指每个视频的平均 H100 生成时间，其中包含去噪和 VAE 解码两个步骤，与图像生成的情况类似。

paragraphs.en: The agent-assisted video demos on the project website demonstrate custom video layout control: users paint a static background detail map and keyframed detail maps to specify where fine and coarse tokens are allocated as subjects move.

paragraphs.en: We disable the learned patch-size embedding introduced in Section 4.2 , removing explicit extent-dependent conditioning of the transformer. paragraphs.en: We show image generation qualitative results of the architectural ablation studies in Fig. 21 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 21 中展示了架构消融研究的图像生成定性结果。

paragraphs.en: LoT gains efficiency by allocating fewer tokens to regions that can be synthesized more coarsely. When fine structures or textures extend across most of an image, as in dense musical notation or close-up views of grass or fabric, preserving them may require a fine token layout throughout, leaving limited room for computational savings. Enforcing a lower token budget in these cases can degrade structural fidelity. As shown in Fig. 22 , the lower-budget result exhibits more fragmented and distorted staff lines than the higher-budget result generated with the same prompt and noise seed. Thus, the achievable savings depend on the scene’s detail requirements, and layout adaptation does not guarantee faithful fine structures under aggressive token reduction.
paragraphs.zh: LoT 通过向可以更粗略合成的区域分配更少的 token 来提高效率。 当精细结构或纹理覆盖图像的大部分区域时（例如密集的乐谱或草叶、织物的特写），要保留这些细节可能需要在整个图像中采用精细的 token 布局，从而留给计算优化的空间有限。 在这些情况下强制降低 token 预算可能会损害结构的保真度。 如图 22 所示，低预算的结果与使用相同提示和噪声种子生成的高预算结果相比，五线谱线条更为破碎和扭曲。 因此，实际可节省的 token 数量取决于场景的细节需求，在大幅削减 token 的情况下，布局自适应也无法保证精细结构的忠实呈现。
